_comment: Tier-scale definitions and the normalization map. Each source declares which scale it uses (sources.json → scale). Values place every tier on one 0–100 axis so sources with different scales can be averaged into a consensus. Consensus bands must be sorted by descending min, ending at 0. NOTE: icyveins-ptr is a SEPARATE scale from icyveins on purpose — Icy Veins' 12.1 PTR lists publish a sixth band (B+) that their live lists do not, and reusing the 5-band icyveins scale would have squashed it into a neighbour. Its shared tiers keep the live anchors exactly (S 100 / A+ 82 / A 66 / B 48 / C 30) so the same author's live and PTR reads are directly comparable on the axis; B+ sits at 57, the midpoint of A and B.
